description: Report which scrcpy version is being used by the MCP server. The version always describes the scrcpy-server file the session pushes: it comes from the SCRCPY_SERVER_VERSION environment variable, or from the scrcpy client belonging to the same install as that server, or a built-in default.
name: version

source.description: Which rung resolved the install: 'env' (SCRCPY_SERVER_VERSION env var), 'binary' (the scrcpy client found on PATH), 'server-sibling' (the client belonging to the server SCRCPY_SERVER_PATH names), 'package-manager' (the client of an install reported by dpkg/pacman/rpm/apk/brew), or 'default' (built-in constant)
